title: 49ers Roll Past Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City as NFL Week 12 Brings Wins for Bills, Chiefs, Bears and Lions — and College Football Delivers Triple-Overtime Thrillers
excerpt: Brock Purdy threw three touchdown passes as San Francisco beat Minnesota 35-10 at Estadio Banorte in Mexico City, while Buffalo, Kansas City, Chicago and Detroit all won in Week 12 and Michigan handed previously unbeaten UCLA its first loss in triple overtime.
content:
MEXICO CITY — The San Francisco 49ers made their trip south of the border count, beating the Minnesota Vikings 35-10 on Sunday at Estadio Banorte in Mexico City. Brock Purdy threw three touchdown passes in the win, and the 49ers improved to 9-1 while the Vikings fell to 7-3.

Around the rest of Week 12, the Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9 to improve to 9-1, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Arizona Cardinals 34-7 to move to 8-2. The two teams meet on Thanksgiving night in Buffalo on Thursday, Nov. 26, in one of the season's biggest games.

The Chicago Bears beat the New Orleans Saints 21-13 to improve to 8-2, and the Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, also moving to 8-2. The Philadelphia Eagles edged the Pittsburgh Steelers 19-16, the Denver Broncos beat the Las Vegas Raiders 38-24, and the Carolina Panthers outlasted the Baltimore Ravens 35-33.

The New York Jets beat the Los Angeles Chargers 27-24, and the New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18. The Houston Texans opened the week Thursday night with a 26-3 win over the Indianapolis Colts.

College football delivered its own drama on Saturday. Michigan handed previously unbeaten and fourth-ranked UCLA its first loss, 18-16 in triple overtime at Ann Arbor, on Bryce Underwood's two-point conversion pass to Jalen Hoffman. Nebraska upset No. 14 Ohio State 31-27 in Lincoln, and Washington beat No. 8 Indiana 27-24 in overtime.

No. 10 BYU survived a triple-overtime thriller of its own, beating Kansas 31-29 in Lawrence on Bear Bachmeier's two-point conversion pass to Jojo Phillips. No. 1 Georgia beat No. 21 South Carolina 34-6, No. 5 Texas beat Arkansas 45-3, No. 6 Notre Dame beat SMU 24-3, No. 9 Tennessee beat LSU 27-13, and Oklahoma beat Texas A&M 28-7.

No. 11 Wake Forest beat Georgia Tech 50-29 in Atlanta behind Gio Lopez, who threw for 324 yards and two touchdowns and added two more scores on the ground.

Sources: Associated Press / Flashscore, Nov. 22, 2026; CBS Sports, Nov. 22, 2026; StatMuse, Nov. 23, 2026; Field Level Media / SRN News, Nov. 22, 2026; AskScores, Nov. 22, 2026.
